component.name: Braincup
component.summary: Train your math skills, memory and focus

description.p: Braincup is a brain training app with a collection of short, focused mini-games that sharpen your mental arithmetic, memory, and attention.

ul.li: Math challenges that grow in difficulty as you improve
Memory games to train recall and pattern recognition
Focus and reaction exercises
Track your progress and personal high scores
Works offline — no account required
Available on Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web
